create_ChatGLMConfig: create a ChatGLMConfig instance with default parameters for a ChatGLM model
create_ChatGLMConfig_custom_layers: create a ChatGLMConfig with a custom number of transformer layers
create_ChatGLMConfig_multi_query: create a ChatGLMConfig with multi-query attention enabled and custom group count
create_ChatGLMConfig_custom_vocab: create a ChatGLMConfig with a custom padded vocabulary size and hidden dimension
create_ChatGLMConfig_prefix_tuning: create a ChatGLMConfig with prefix tuning enabled using pre_seq_len and prefix_projection
